verdicts.line: You roar — and everyone who witnesses it is frightened, whatever you intend.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: the roar frightens all who witness it, whatever you intend
verdicts.reason: Direct lift from the tutorial narration example in §2.5, preserving the crucial 'whatever you intend' clause that makes this uhta-specific.

verdicts.line: Roar. The earth shatters ahead of you. Everyone who sees it happen is afraid.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: you roar and the earth shatters ahead
verdicts.reason: Combines the tutorial's 'you roar and the earth shatters ahead' with the witness-fear mechanic, maintaining instrumentation register.

verdicts.line: The roar frightens all who witness it, whatever you intend.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: The narration is instrumentation, not lore — short declarative lines, no mythology
verdicts.reason: Missing the verb-naming structure required by the tutorial format; reads as lore statement rather than action-consequence instruction.
verdicts.correction: You roar — the earth shatters, and all who witness it are frightened, whatever you intend.

verdicts.line: You roar and the ground breaks open. Those who watch are frightened — even by hope.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: NPCs within witness radius R (~6 tiles) of the line take an unconditional Fear push (~2.8) regardless of flame color
verdicts.reason: The 'even by hope' clause directly captures the 'regardless of flame color' mechanic that makes roar uniquely unconditional.

verdicts.line: Roar — the line breaks, and everyone near enough to see is pushed toward fear.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: NPCs within witness radius R (~6 tiles) of the line take an unconditional Fear push
verdicts.reason: The phrase 'pushed toward fear' contradicts the chunks' consistent language of an 'unconditional Fear push' — this isn't gradual movement but immediate application.
verdicts.correction: Roar — the line breaks, and everyone near enough to see takes fear, whatever your flame.

verdicts.line: When you roar, the earth splits. Anyone who witnesses the break is frightened, regardless of your flame.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: NPCs within witness radius R (~6 tiles) of the line take an unconditional Fear push (~2.8) regardless of flame color
verdicts.reason: Accurately names the verb, states terrain and emotional consequence, and preserves the 'regardless of your flame' clause that defines roar's uniqueness.

verdicts.line: You roar. It clears a path — and frightens everyone close enough to see, no matter what color you carry.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: Shatters a line of tiles — fast traversal / path creation. NPCs within witness radius R (~6 tiles) of the line take an unconditional Fear push (~2.8) regardless of flame color
verdicts.reason: Integrates fast-travel function with witness-fear mechanic and the critical 'no matter what color you carry' clause in tutorial register.

verdicts.line: Roar: fast travel, and unconditional fear for those who watch it happen.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: the roar frightens all who witness it, whatever you intend
verdicts.reason: Colon-label format strips away the 'whatever you intend' clause that makes this uhta-specific; could describe any AOE fear ability in any game.
verdicts.correction: Roar: shatters a line of ground for fast travel, and frightens everyone who witnesses it — whatever you intend.
